caption: The drawing depicts a single oval plate positioned horizontally in the center of the image, rendered with a light gray inner area and a decorative border in varying shades of blue. The border is adorned with alternating circular and floral motifs, with the circles rendered in white surrounded by dark blue, and the floral motifs in white against a lighter blue background. Directly beneath the plate, there are three additional elements: to the left, a small insignia or crest with a shield and decorative flourishes; in the center, a simplified line drawing showing the plate from a top and side perspective; and to the right, a handwritten signature reading "Jos Sudeck". The plate and accompanying elements are outlined with fine lines, while the main plate's decorative border is colored. The background is an uncolored, light tan paper.
title: Saucer
